description: Find MCP servers for a task or product (for example: Stripe payments, browser automation). Returns matching servers from Stork's directory, each with how to connect, whether its endpoint answered Stork's last check, how many tokens its tool definitions take, and what Stork's own test calls saw.

live_only.description: Only servers whose endpoint answered the last check without an account.

max_tool_tokens.description: Only servers whose tool definitions are estimated at or under this many tokens.

name: stork_find_server
title: Find an MCP server
